ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure fragment. At the top there is a carbonyl-style C=O, with O above, and the central carbon connected to R1 on the left and R2 on the right; below there is a nitrogen-containing group, with N connected to H, R3, and R4. The figure also shows curved arrows from near nitrogen toward the central carbon and near the carbonyl oxygen; there is a short horizontal line on the right. Reasoning: Ignore the arrows according to the problem statement, and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. The countable non-hydrogen bond connections are: 1 C=O double bond, 1 C-R1 single bond, 1 C-R2 single bond, 1 N-R3 single bond, and 1 N-R4 single bond. The N-H bond is not counted. Therefore the total is 5.
